reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was 200 mg elemental, fully chelated, no oxide, plus the QR to a named ISO 17025 lab report, which is exactly what I check for. $29.99 for 30 days is fair if the batch report really opens and matches the label, so I'd try one box.
objection: A new brand on TikTok Shop with only a creator video behind it. I want to see the actual lab report and know whether 200 mg at once will upset my stomach, and whether I'll really feel a difference in sleep or cramps.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR opened a real, named lab report for the exact batch with magnesium content and heavy metals that match the label, I'd be fully in. If it didn't open or the lab couldn't be verified, I'd pass.
